def compute_tp_gnn_loss(
    positive_scores,
    negative_scores,
    embeddings,
    positive_sources,
    positive_targets,
    negative_sources,
    negative_targets,
    source_batch_size,
    epoch,
    max_epochs,
    graph_scores,
    graph_sources,
    graph_targets,
    graph_net_ids,
    graph_weights,
    net_weights,
    node_features,
    node_areas,
):
    """Mechanism: keep the random-walk contrastive loss and modulate positive-pair pressure by a coverage-aware, slack-standardized criticality derived from node_features; Decision: critical supernodes with valid timing coverage pull their positive neighbors together more strongly, while negative sampling remains unchanged, so embedding geometry shifts through feature-conditioned positive edges rather than graph-star penalties; Prediction: matched-case combined timing should improve when timing-critical groups are better separated before the frozen area-balanced two-means decoder assigns tiers, with the largest changes on cases whose critical positive pairs are underweighted by the legacy loss; Falsifier: matched-case combined score fails to improve while positive-pair weights and decoder assignments remain effectively unchanged."""
    slack = node_features[:, 0]
    coverage = torch.clamp(node_features[:, 6], min=0.0, max=1.0)
    coverage_total = torch.clamp(coverage.sum(), min=1e-6)
    slack_center = (slack * coverage).sum() / coverage_total
    slack_var = (torch.square(slack - slack_center) * coverage).sum() / coverage_total
    slack_scale = torch.sqrt(torch.clamp(slack_var, min=1e-6))
    node_criticality = coverage * torch.sigmoid(-(slack - slack_center) / slack_scale)
    positive_criticality = 0.5 * (
        node_criticality[positive_sources] + node_criticality[positive_targets]
    )
    positive_weights = 1.0 + 0.75 * positive_criticality
    pair_loss = -(
        (positive_weights * F.logsigmoid(positive_scores)).sum()
        + F.logsigmoid(-negative_scores).sum()
    ) / max(1, source_batch_size)
    return pair_loss


def decode_tp_gnn_embeddings(embeddings, node_areas, seed, max_iterations, balance_target):
    """Reproduce the frozen area-balanced global two-way decoder."""
    return reference_global_two_way(embeddings, node_areas, seed, max_iterations, balance_target)
